annotations.title: Preview the complete replacement execution policy

description: Preview the complete replacement execution policy. Conversation reply grants remain separate; explicit communication review exceptions apply to replies too. Optional partial (run the leading qualifying steps, leave the rest with a person) is off when omitted. Money limits (refund, credit and daily totals in cents) default to $200 per refund, $100 per credit and $500 in 24 hours when omitted. Returns an exact preview hash; changes nothing.

family.description: An action family: reply, closure, record, vendor_contact, clinician_note, address_cancel or money. With mode review, the rule holds every action in the family (a kill switch). An automatic family rule does not lift the Slack hold unless it also names the slack channel.

money.description: Money limits for auto-run, in whole cents. Omitted: a refund up to 20000 ($200), a credit up to 10000 ($100) and 50000 ($500) in any 24 hours. Set the limits to 0 to make all money wait for a person. Charges and promotions always wait for a person.

creditCentsMax.description: Largest single account credit that may run automatically. Omitted: credits wait for a person.

dailyCentsMax.description: Most refunds and credits that auto-run may approve in any 24 hours, across the company and environment.

refundCentsMax.description: Largest single refund that may run automatically. Omitted: refunds wait for a person.

partial.description: When true, auto-run may run the leading steps of a plan that qualify and leave the remaining steps, and every case closure, waiting for a person. Off when omitted.
